ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Tech Level Fixes
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Rewrites the tech level of items, to the level arbitrated for each one with the cherrypick tool, mod by mod.
Every file under Patches/ is generated: one per source mod, named after its packageId. Deleting a file undoes that mod's corrections; deleting the folder undoes everything.
It loads after the mods it corrects, listed in loadAfter, so their own patches have already run. None of them is required: a correction whose item is missing does nothing.
